prompt: Our editorial team needs a structured daily news briefing. We have raw news data collected from various domestic and international sources sitting in the workspace under the `raw_feeds/` directory. Please process all of these files and produce a single consolidated report called `daily_briefing.md`. The report should cover both technology and military topics, and only include news from reliable, authoritative sources — please discard anything from forums, anonymous tips, or unverified secondhand posts. If the same story appears in multiple sources, include it only once.
